name: counselcodex
description: Auditable Mastra disposition workflow for synthetic patient messages.

scripts.rag:test: MASTRA_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/clinical-rag.test.ts tests/clinical-graph.test.ts tests/physician-cohort.test.ts tests/fact-graph.test.ts tests/clinical-policy.test.ts tests/graph-judge-calibration.test.ts tests/graph-judge-study.test.ts
scripts.adaptive:test: MASTRA_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/routing-policy.test.ts tests/clarification-policy.test.ts tests/evidence-search.test.ts tests/disposition-adaptive.test.ts tests/disposition-reconciliation.test.ts tests/disposition-recovery.test.ts tests/disposition-transport.test.ts tests/disposition-conversation.test.ts tests/disposition-experiment.test.ts
scripts.disposition:test: MASTRA_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/disposition-agent.test.ts tests/disposition-progressive.test.ts tests/disposition-compact.test.ts tests/disposition-nasal.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:candidate && npm run build:mastra
scripts.build:candidate: npm run build --workspace @counselcodex/evaluation && npm run build:candidate:verify
scripts.build:mastra: MASTRA_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true mastra build && npm run build:mastra:verify
scripts.build:verify: npm run build:candidate:verify && npm run build:mastra:verify
scripts.holdout:eval: npm run retrieval:holdout && npm run agent:holdout
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run review:test && npm run redteam && npm run evaluate && npm run ablate && npm run pre-adjudication:eval && npm run holdout:verify && npm run evaluation:readiness && npm run mastra:eval && npm run agent:eval && npm run mastra:smoke && npm run build
scripts.test:mastra: COUNSEL_MASTRA_TEST_STORAGE=isolated node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/mastra.test.ts tests/clinical-agent.test.ts tests/disposition-agent.test.ts tests/disposition-progressive.test.ts tests/disposition-compact.test.ts tests/disposition-nasal.test.ts

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:mastra && npm run test:cqa && npm run evidence:test && npm run adaptive:test && npm run review:judge-test && npm run clinical:benchmark-test && npm run rag:test && npm run test:study && npm run test:gates
